facts.text: I live only in Antarctica, the coldest place on Earth.
I'm the tallest and heaviest penguin in the world!
Dads keep our egg warm for two whole months.
We huddle close together to stay warm in the cold.
I can dive deeper than 500 meters to find food!
I can stay underwater for about 20 minutes!
I can't fly, but I slide on my belly over the ice!
Scientists use satellites in space to find and count us!

toys.then: As a chick, I was fluffy and grey!
toys.now: Grown up, I'm black, white and yellow.

toys.caption: I'm almost as tall as you!
